english: Switch Targeting If you see a [Control Stick] icon above an  object, you can target it with [C-Left]. --- PAGE --- In other words, if you press [C-Left]  when you see [Control Stick] above an object, you can lock on to it. --- PAGE --- If you press [C-Left] again, the lock will either release or it will transfer to the next object with the [Control Stick] above it. --- PAGE --- When you have many enemies in your field of view and you want to escape, press [C-Left] while holding back on [D-Pad] to cancel targeting. --- PAGE --- You can target the stones next to this sign for practice!

english: There are three kinds of items: Equipment items, [C] Button items and Quest items. --- PAGE --- Equipment items are things like  the sword, shield and clothes  that are effective when you equip them. --- PAGE --- [C] Button items can be set to  [R], [L], and [Z], and used by pressing those buttons. --- PAGE --- Quest items are things you  collect during your adventure. You just carry them around. --- PAGE --- If you want to change equipment or just check on your inventory, press START.  You will get into the Subscreens. --- PAGE --- Switch to one of the four  different Subscreens with [C-Left] or [C-Down] and change or check items as you please. Take a look around! --- PAGE --- When you decide to equip an  Equipment item, press [A]. For [C] Button items, press [R], [L] or [Z]. --- PAGE --- That was a pretty long explanation. Did you understand everything?
spanish: Hay tres tipos de objetos: Objetos de Equipo, objetos de botón [C] y objetos de Misión. --- PAGE --- Los Objetos de Equipo son cosas como la espada, el escudo y la ropa que son efectivos cuando te los equipas. --- PAGE --- Los objetos de botón [C] pueden asignarse a [R], [L] y [Z], y usarse presionando esos botones. --- PAGE --- Los objetos de Misión son cosas que recoges durante tu aventura. Solo los cargas contigo. --- PAGE --- Si quieres cambiar el equipo o solo revisar tu inventario, presiona START. Entrarás a las pantallas secundarias. --- PAGE --- Cambia a una de las cuatro diferentes pantallas secundarias con [C-Left] o [C-Down] y cambia o revisa objetos como quieras. ¡Echa un vistazo! --- PAGE --- Cuando decidas equipar un objeto de equipo, presiona [A]. Para objetos de botón [C], presiona [R], [L] o [Z]. --- PAGE --- Eso fue una explicación bastante largas. ¿Entendiste todo?

english: Oh, Navi the fairy... Listen to my words, the words of  the Deku Tree... --- PAGE --- Dost thou sense it? The climate of evil descending  upon this realm... --- PAGE --- Malevolent forces even now are mustering to attack our land of Hyrule... --- PAGE --- For so long, the Kokiri Forest, the source of life, has stood as a  barrier, deterring outsiders and  maintaining the order of the world... --- PAGE --- But...before this tremendous evil power, even my power is as  nothing... --- PAGE --- It seems the time has come for  the boy without a fairy to begin  his journey... --- PAGE --- The youth whose destiny it is to lead Hyrule to the path of  justice and truth... --- PAGE --- Navi...go now! Find our young friend and guide him to me... --- PAGE --- I do not have much time left. --- PAGE --- Fly, Navi, fly! The fate of the forest, nay, the world, depends upon thee!
spanish: Oh, Navi el hada... Escucha mis palabras, las palabras del Árbol Deku... --- PAGE --- ¿Lo sientes? El clima de malicia descendiendo sobre este reino... --- PAGE --- Fuerzas malévolas incluso ahora se están reuniendo para atacar nuestra tierra de Hyrule... --- PAGE --- Por tanto tiempo, el Bosque Kokiri, la fuente de la vida, ha permanecido como una barrera, disuadiendo a los extraños y manteniendo el orden del mundo... --- PAGE --- Pero... ante este tremendo poder malvado, incluso mi poder es como nada... --- PAGE --- Parece que el tiempo ha llegado para que el chico sin hada comience su viaje... --- PAGE --- ¡El joven cuyo destino es llevar a Hyrule por el camino ¡de la justicia y la verdad! --- PAGE --- ¡Navi... ve ahora! Encuentra a nuestro joven amigo y guíaselo... --- PAGE --- No me queda mucho tiempo. --- PAGE --- Vuela, Navi, ¡vuela! El destino del bosque, no, del mundo, depende de ti.

english: Young lad, you play the Ocarina well... Mmmmm...! That melody is  so fine...ribbit! We all should practice it, ribbit! --- PAGE --- Take Rupees as a souvenir! If you come up with another nice  melody, please drop by and play it...Ribbit ribbit!
spanish: Joven, tocas la Ocarina  bien... ¡Mmmmm...! ¡Esa melodía es  tan hermosa... croac! ¡Todos deberíamos  practicarla, croac! --- PAGE --- ¡Toma Rupias como recuerdo! Si se te ocurre otra buena  melodía, por favor pasa y toca  la... ¡Croac croac!
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: Wow, that melody is so cool!  Ribbit! --- PAGE --- Siiiiingin' in the raaaaaain, Oh what a feeling!  Rrrrrribbbit!! --- PAGE --- Please take this as a token of our froggish gratitude, ribbit! All right. See you, ribbit!
spanish: ¡Vaya, esa melodía es tan genial! Croac! --- PAGE --- ¡Cantando bajo la lluuuvia, ¡Oh qué sensación! ¡Croaaac!! --- PAGE --- Por favor toma esto como símbolo  de nuestra gratitud ranuna, croac! ¡A ver, hasta luego, croac!
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: GYAAAH! You killed me!! Huh? Oh, it's you. --- PAGE --- Did you try to play the  Sun's Song? --- PAGE --- Like I told you before, with that  song, you can turn day to night  or night to day whenever you  want. --- PAGE --- When you're in darkness, that  song should bring the sun's light to you. You should try it.
spanish: ¡¡GYAAAH!! ¡¡Me mataste!! ¿Eh? Oh, eres tú. --- PAGE --- ¿Intentaste tocar la  Canción del Sol? --- PAGE --- Como te dije antes, con esa  canción puedes cambiar el día por la noche  o la noche por el día cuando  quieras. --- PAGE --- Cuando estés en la oscuridad, esa  canción debería traerte la luz del sol. Deberías probarla.
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: The rising sun will eventually set, A newborn's life will fade. --- PAGE --- From sun to moon, moon to sun... --- PAGE --- Give peaceful rest to the living dead. --- PAGE --- This is an interesting poem... huh?
spanish: El sol naciente eventualmente se pondrá, la vida de un recién nacido se desvanecerá. --- PAGE --- Del sol a la luna, de la luna al sol... --- PAGE --- Dale un descanso pacífico a los muertos vivientes. --- PAGE --- Este es un poema interesante... ¿eh?
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: Restless souls wander where they don't belong, bring them calm with the Sun's Song.
spanish: Las almas inquietas vagan por donde no pertenecen, llevales calma con la Canción del Sol.
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: Something is inscribed on the  tombstone... --- PAGE --- It's the secret melody of the  Composer Brothers!
spanish: Algo está inscrito en la  tumba... --- PAGE --- ¡Es la melodía secreta de los Hermanos Compositores!
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: To tell the truth, each of us was studying a different song, one to summon the sun and another to summon the moon. --- PAGE --- If you were really sent by a  member of the Royal Family, I will tell you about the results of our study. --- PAGE --- We inscribed it on the royal tombstone. --- PAGE --- As a messenger of the Royal  Family, you should show your Royal credentials on top of the  Triforce mark...
spanish: Para decir la verdad, cada uno de nosotros estudiaba una canción diferente, una para invocar al sol y otra para invocar a la luna. --- PAGE --- Si realmente te envió un miembro de la Familia Real, te contaré sobre los resultados de nuestro estudio. --- PAGE --- Lo inscribimos en la tumba real. --- PAGE --- Como mensajero de la Familia Real, deberías mostrar tus credenciales reales sobre la marca de la Trifuerza...
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: I believe Impa has gone to the  Shadow Temple to seal it again, but...she will be in danger without  any help! --- PAGE --- [PLAYER]! Impa is one of the six Sages. Destroy the evil shadow spirit and save Impa! --- PAGE --- There is an entrance to the  Shadow Temple beneath the  graveyard behind this village. --- PAGE --- The only thing I can do for you is teach you the melody that will lead you to the Shadow Temple... --- PAGE --- This is the melody that will draw you into the infinite darkness  that absorbs even time... Listen to  this, the Nocturne of Shadow!!
spanish: Creo que Impa fue al Templo de la Sombra para sellarlo de nuevo, pero... ¡estará en peligro sin ninguna ayuda! --- PAGE --- ¡[PLAYER]! Impa es una de las seis Sabias. ¡Destruye al espíritu sombrío maligno y salva a Impa! --- PAGE --- Hay una entrada al Templo de la Sombra debajo del cementerio detrás de este pueblo. --- PAGE --- Lo único que puedo hacer por ti es enseñarte la melodía que te llevará al Templo de la Sombra... --- PAGE --- Esta es la melodía que te llevará a la oscuridad infinita que absorbe incluso el tiempo... ¡Escucha esto, el Nocturno de la Sombra!
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: Ding dong, ding dong! I'm a clock soldier of Kakariko! The current time is: . --- PAGE --- Hello there, son. Zelda's attendant, the great Impa, opened this village to the common people. --- PAGE --- We have only a small population  now, but someday this place will  be as lively as Hyrule Castle  Town! Oh, yes! It will! --- PAGE --- Climb up the stairs at the north end of the village to find the trail that leads up Death Mountain. --- PAGE --- But you need the King's permission to actually go up the mountain.
spanish: Ding dong, ding dong. ¡Soy un soldado relojero de Kakariko! La hora actual es: . --- PAGE --- Hola, hijo. La asistente de Zelda, la gran Impa, abrió este pueblo para la gente común. --- PAGE --- Ahora solo tenemos una pequeña población, pero algún día este lugar será tan animado como la Ciudad del Castillo de Hyrule. ¡Oh, sí! ¡Lo será! --- PAGE --- Sube las escaleras en el extremo norte del pueblo para encontrar el camino que lleva al Monte Muerte. --- PAGE --- Pero necesitas el permiso del Rey para realmente subir la montaña.
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: Ding dong, ding dong! The current time is: . --- PAGE --- Head east and you'll find a graveyard. Legends say you can  calm the souls of the dead with an old song of the Royal Family.
spanish: Ding dong, ding dong. La hora actual es: . --- PAGE --- Ve al este y encontrarás un cementerio. Las leyendas dicen que puedes calmar las almas de los muertos con una vieja canción de la Familia Real.
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: There he is! It's him! He's the one who dropped from the sky surrounded by a blue light! --- PAGE --- Now do you believe me?
spanish: ¡Ahí está! ¡Es él! ¡Es el que cayó del cielo rodeado de una luz azul! --- PAGE --- ¿Ahora me crees?
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: Past, present, future... --- PAGE --- The Master Sword is a ship with  which you can sail upstream and downstream through time's river... --- PAGE --- The port for that ship is in the Temple of Time... --- PAGE --- To restore the Desert Colossus and enter the Spirit Temple, you must travel back through time's flow... --- PAGE --- Listen to this Requiem of Spirit... This melody will lead a child back to the desert.
spanish: Pasado, presente, futuro... --- PAGE --- La Espada Maestra es un barco con el cual puedes navegar río arriba y río abajo a través del río del tiempo... --- PAGE --- El puerto de ese barco está en el Templo del Tiempo... --- PAGE --- Para restaurar al Coloso del Desierto y entrar al Templo del Espíritu, debes viajar de regreso a través del flujo del tiempo... --- PAGE --- Escucha este Réquiem del Espíritu... Esta melodía llevará a un niño de regreso al desierto.
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: With my flame, I will burn him to the bone!
spanish: ¡Con mi llama, lo quemaré hasta los huesos!
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: I was afraid you were going to  forget about me! Now I'm free! Thanks! I'm Shiro the carpenter. --- PAGE --- For rescuing me, I'll tell you something interesting about the desert that I overheard the Gerudos talking about. --- PAGE --- They said, "In order to cross the Haunted Wasteland, you'll need the 'eye of truth.' The Colossus is on the far side of the wasteland..." --- PAGE --- OK, now I'm going back to my tent near Gerudo Valley, so,  drop by sometime. You may find  something helpful there! Byeee!
spanish: ¡Tenía miedo de que fueras a olvidarme! ¡Ahora soy libre! ¡Gracias! Soy Shiro el carpintero. --- PAGE --- Por rescatarme, te contaré algo interesante sobre el desert que escuché a las Gerudo hablando. --- PAGE --- Dijeron: "Para cruzar el Desierto Encantado, necesitarás el 'ojo de la verdad'. El Coloso está al otro lado del desierto..." --- PAGE --- Bien, ahora voy a volver a mi carpa cerca del Valle Gerudo, así que pásate por aquí. ¡Podrás encontrar algo útil! ¡Chao!
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: From now on, the future of all the people in Hyrule is on your  shoulders. --- PAGE --- Maybe it's not my time anymore.  Here is my last advice. --- PAGE --- Two witches inhabit this temple. In  order to destroy them, turn their  own magic power against them. Hoo hoot!
spanish: De ahora en adelante, el futuro de toda la gente de Hyrule está sobre tus hombros. --- PAGE --- Quizás ya no es mi momento. Aquí está mi último consejo. --- PAGE --- Dos brujas habitan este templo. Para destruirlas, usa su propio poder mágico en su contra. ¡Hoo hoot!
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: Can you see the man with the  evil eyes? --- PAGE --- That is Ganondorf, the leader of  the Gerudos. They hail from the  desert far to the west. --- PAGE --- Though he swears allegiance to my  father, I am sure he is not  sincere. --- PAGE --- The dark clouds that covered  Hyrule in my dream... They must symbolize that man!
spanish: ¿Puedes ver al hombre con los ojos malvados? --- PAGE --- Ese es Ganondorf, el líder de las Gerudo. Ellas provienen del desierto lejano al oeste. --- PAGE --- Aunque jura lealtad a mi padre, estoy segura de que no es sincero. --- PAGE --- Las nubes oscuras que cubrían Hyrule en mi sueño... ¡Deben simbolizar a ese hombre!
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: It seems like it's taking forever for dawn to come... --- PAGE --- The view of Hyrule Castle in  the morning sun is so fantastic!
spanish: Parece que tarda una eternidad en llegar el amanecer... --- PAGE --- ¡La vista del Castillo de Hyrule con el sol de la mañana es fantástica!
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: They say we Hylians have big ears in order to hear the voices of the  gods...but I've never heard them!
spanish: Dicen que nosotros los hylianos tenemos orejas grandes para escuchar las voces de los dioses... ¡pero yo nunca las he oído!
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: To get to Lon Lon Ranch, after you leave town, head due south across the field. You should visit the ranch at least once!
spanish: Para llegar a Granja Lon Lon, después de que salgas de la ciudad, ve hacia el sur a través del campo. ¡Deberías visitar la granja al menos una vez!
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: That's right... The Temple of Time is the entrance through which you can enter the Sacred Realm from our world. --- PAGE --- But the entrance is sealed with a stone wall called the  Door of Time. --- PAGE --- And, in order to open the door, it is said that you need to collect three Spiritual Stones. --- PAGE --- And another thing you need...is the treasure that the Royal Family keeps along with this legend...
spanish: Así es... El Templo del Tiempo es la entrada por la cual puedes entrar al Reino Sagrado desde nuestro mundo. --- PAGE --- Pero la entrada está sellada con una pared de piedra llamada la Puerta del Tiempo. --- PAGE --- Y, para abrir la puerta, dicen que necesitas reunir tres Piedras Espirituales. --- PAGE --- Y otra cosa que necesitas... es el tesoro que la Familia Real guarda junto con esta leyenda...
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: The Spiritual Stone... You finally found it! --- PAGE --- It is said that the races that hold the Spiritual Stones open their minds only to one who knows the melody of the Royal Family. --- PAGE --- But you already know that, don't you?
spanish: La Piedra Espiritual... ¡Por fin la encontraste! --- PAGE --- Dicen que las razas que poseen las Piedras Espirituales abren sus mentes solo a quien conoce la melodía de la Familia Real. --- PAGE --- Pero ya lo sabes, ¿no?
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: I am Rauru, one of the ancient Sages... --- PAGE --- Ages ago, we ancient Sages built the Temple of Time to  protect the entrance to the Sacred Realm... --- PAGE --- This is the Chamber of Sages,  inside the Temple of Light... --- PAGE --- The Temple of Light, situated in the very center of the Sacred  Realm, is the last stronghold  against Ganondorf's evil forces. --- PAGE --- The Master Sword--the evil- destroying sword that you pulled out of the Pedestal of Time--was  the final key to the Sacred Realm. --- PAGE --- [PLAYER]... Don't be alarmed... Look at yourself...!
spanish: Soy Rauru, uno de los antiguos Sabios... --- PAGE --- Hace edades, nosotros los antiguos Sabios construimos el Templo del Tiempo para proteger la entrada al Reino Sagrado... --- PAGE --- Esta es la Cámara de Sabios, dentro del Templo de la Luz... --- PAGE --- El Templo de la Luz, situado en el centro mismo del Reino Sagrado, es la última fortaleza contra las fuerzas malvadas de Ganondorf. --- PAGE --- La Espada Maestra, la espada destruyente del mal que sacaste del Pedestal del Tiempo, fue la llave final al Reino Sagrado. --- PAGE --- [PLAYER]... No te alarmes... ¡Mírate...!
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: But, remember... --- PAGE --- Though you opened the Door of  Time in the name of peace... --- PAGE --- Ganondorf, the Gerudo King of Thieves, used it to enter this  forbidden Sacred Realm! --- PAGE --- He obtained the Triforce from the Temple of Light, and with its  power, he became the King of Evil... --- PAGE --- His evil power radiated from the temples of Hyrule, and in seven short years, it transformed Hyrule into a world of monsters. --- PAGE --- My power now has only little  influence, even in this Sacred Realm... --- PAGE --- Namely, this Chamber of Sages. --- PAGE --- But there is still hope... --- PAGE --- The power of the Sages remains. --- PAGE --- When the power of all the Sages is awakened... --- PAGE --- The Sages' Seals will contain all the evil power in the void of  the Realm... --- PAGE --- I, Rauru, am one of the Sages... And... --- PAGE --- Your power to fight together with the Sages makes you the  Hero of Time! --- PAGE --- The Hero of Time, chosen by the Master Sword! --- PAGE --- Keep my spirit with you... And, find the power of the other Sages and add their might to your own!
spanish: Pero, recuerda... --- PAGE --- Aunque abriste la Puerta del Tiempo en nombre de la paz... --- PAGE --- Ganondorf, el Rey Gerudo de Los Ladrones, la usó para entrar en este prohibido Reino Sagrado! --- PAGE --- Obtuvo el Trifuerza del Templo de la Luz, y con su poder, se convirtió en el Rey del Mal... --- PAGE --- Su poder maligno irradió desde los templos de Hyrule, y en solo siete años, transformó Hyrule en un mundo de monstruos. --- PAGE --- Mi poder ahora tiene solo poca influencia, incluso en este Reino Sagrado... --- PAGE --- Es decir, esta Cámara de Sabios. --- PAGE --- Pero aún hay esperanza... --- PAGE --- El poder de los Sabios permanece. --- PAGE --- Cuando el poder de todos los Sabios despierte... --- PAGE --- ¡Los Sellos de los Sabios contendrán todo el poder maligno en el vacío del Reino... --- PAGE --- Yo, Rauru, soy uno de los Sabios... Y... --- PAGE --- ¡Tu poder para luchar junto con los Sabios te convierte en el Héroe del Tiempo! --- PAGE --- ¡El Héroe del Tiempo, elegido por la Espada Maestra! --- PAGE --- ¡Guarda mi espíritu contigo... Y, encuentra el poder de los otros Sabios y añade su fuerza a la tuya!
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: When evil rules all, an awakening voice from the Sacred Realm will call those destined to be Sages, who dwell in the five temples. --- PAGE --- One in a deep forest... --- PAGE --- One on a high mountain... --- PAGE --- One under a vast lake... --- PAGE --- One within the house of the dead... --- PAGE --- One inside a goddess of the sand... --- PAGE --- Together with the Hero of Time,  the awakened ones will bind the evil and return the light of peace to the world... --- PAGE --- This is the legend of the temples passed down by my people, the Sheikah.
spanish: Cuando el mal gobierne todo, una voz de despertar del Reino Sagrado llamará a los destinados a ser Sabios, que habitan en los cinco templos. --- PAGE --- Uno en un bosque profundo... --- PAGE --- Uno en una montaña alta... --- PAGE --- Uno bajo un vasto lago... --- PAGE --- Uno dentro de la casa de los muertos... --- PAGE --- Uno dentro de una diosa de la arena... --- PAGE --- Junto con el Héroe del Tiempo, los despertados encadenarán al mal y devolverán la luz de la paz al mundo... --- PAGE --- Esta es la leyenda de los templos pasada por mi pueblo, los Sheikah.
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: You destroyed the wicked creatures that haunted the temple and awakened the Sage... --- PAGE --- But there are still other Sages who need your help. --- PAGE --- In order to awaken all the other Sages, you must become even more powerful. --- PAGE --- You must travel over mountains... --- PAGE --- under water... --- PAGE --- and even through time...
spanish: Destruiste a las criaturas malvadas que acechaban el templo despertaste al Sabio... --- PAGE --- Pero aún hay otros Sabios que necesitan tu ayuda. --- PAGE --- Para despertar a todos los otros Sabios, debes ser aún más poderoso. --- PAGE --- Debes viajar sobre montañas... --- PAGE --- bajo el agua... --- PAGE --- y incluso a través del tiempo...
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: The six Sages will open the sealed door and lure Ganondorf back into the Sacred Realm. --- PAGE --- I will then seal the door to the  Sacred Realm from this world. --- PAGE --- Thus, Ganondorf the Evil King will vanish from Hyrule. --- PAGE --- [PLAYER]... In order to do this, I need your  courage again. Please protect me while I do my part. --- PAGE --- And here is a weapon that can  penetrate the Evil King's defenses... The power given to the chosen  ones... --- PAGE --- The sacred Arrow of Light!!!
spanish: Los seis Sabios abrirán la puerta sellada y atraerán a Ganondorf de vuelta al Reino Sagrado. --- PAGE --- Luego sellaré la puerta del Reino Sagrado desde este mundo. --- PAGE --- Así, Ganondorf el Rey Maligno desaparecerá de Hyrule. --- PAGE --- [PLAYER]... Para hacer esto, necesito tu coraje de nuevo. Por favor protégeme mientras hago mi parte. --- PAGE --- Y aquí está un arma que puede penetrar las defensas del Rey Maligno... El poder otorgado a los elegidos... --- PAGE --- ¡¡¡La sagrada Flecha de la Luz!!!
notes: Cardinal directions, quantities, and sequence condition logic certified

english: The time will come when you will have to return here quickly... I will teach this to you for when  that time comes... --- PAGE --- The song to return you to the  Temple of Time... The Prelude of Light...
spanish: Llegará el momento en que tendrás que volver aquí rápidamente... Te enseñaré esto para cuando ese momento llegue... --- PAGE --- La canción que te devolverá al Templo del Tiempo... Preludio de la Luz...

english: You are a courageous boy... You are heading out on a big, new  adventure, aren't you? --- PAGE --- My role in the Princess's dream was to teach a melody to the one from the forest. --- PAGE --- This is an ancient melody passed  down by the Royal Family. --- PAGE --- I have played this song for  Princess Zelda as a lullaby ever since she was a baby... --- PAGE --- There is mysterious power in  these notes. --- PAGE --- Now listen carefully...
spanish: Eres un chico valiente...
